title: Deepfake public clarification (fictional)
promptText:
You are drafting for a Public Information Officer.

Scenario (FICTIONAL): A WhatsApp forward claims to be a voice note from a senior officer ordering immediate feeder shutdowns. It has not been verified.

Draft a 90-word clarification for official channels that:
- Does not amplify the fake audio
- Asks citizens to ignore unverified forwards
- Points only to official MahaTransco channels
- Avoids naming any real living official
- Reminds staff of the PAUSE → VERIFY habit

Mark any operational facts as [VERIFY].
